item.tinkersarsenal.boomstick.descriptio: The Boomstick is a gun capable of firing powerful shots. It has to be loaded beforehand by using right click, but can be used at any moment afterwards. Uses Boomstick shots and gunpowder.
item.tinkersarsenal.boomstick_shot.descr: The Boomstick Shots are used as ammo for the Boomstick (alongside gunpowder). One stack provides many shots, and they can be modified as any tool.
